offering_description.value: Cultivates, processes and sells medical and adult-use cannabis products. Sells to patients and consumers through its own retail dispensaries and to other licensed retailers wholesale, with products grown and made in-house.

primary_products.value: cannabis flower; vape cartridges; edibles; concentrates; topicals

customer_segment.value: B2C: medical cannabis patients and adult-use consumers; B2B: licensed third-party dispensaries buying wholesale

revenue_model.value: product sales: retail sales of cannabis products in own dispensaries; product sales: wholesale sales to licensed dispensaries

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: grows and processes cannabis into finished products, sold to consumers and licensed retailers; retailer: operates branded dispensaries selling to patients and consumers; brand owner: owns multiple cannabis product brands

geography_served.value: US regional: Licensed states including Florida, Pennsylvania, Arizona, Georgia, Ohio, Maryland, Massachusetts, West Virginia and others

specialization.value: related lines: cultivation, product manufacturing and retail of cannabis

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned retail dispensaries; distributors / dealers: wholesale to third-party licensed dispensaries; online: online ordering and delivery in some states

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state cannabis licensing and regulation, federally illegal in the US, with DEA scheduling and banking restrictions
